visual_review: VRECT_L: one mast running through two bowl sails (topsail rx9/ry7, course rx13/ry7) with overhanging yards, over a hull with a raised pointed bow and a raised slanted stern, rounded keel. Follows the reference layout; mast off-centre so the bow reads.
omissions: Masthead stub above the top yard and the course's three scallops reduced to one bowl (40-unit height budget at 8 spacing).
